notes.title: Magical Eyes - Red is For Anguish Now Out!
notes.notes:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2016/03/me-poster-2-halfsize.png[/img]
POMERA Studios' mystery visual novel, Magical Eyes - Red is for Anguish is now available on Steam! 

Meet Yuu, Chiharu and the other quirky characters, and enter the battle between Variants, supernatural entities that disrupt our world, and the Disobeyers who fight them in the shadows.

As a special bonus, all copies include an official digital artbook for the game. See you on the other side!

notes.title: Official Artbook Added!
notes.notes:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2016/03/00hs.jpg[/img]
We're happy to announce that a free digital copy of the all-new official artbook of [b]Magical Eyes - Red is for Anguish[/b] will be included with the game, courtesy of [b]POMERA Studios[/b].

The artbook contains character profiles, gorgeous artwork with creators' comments, and more!
